shortDescription: Create or Update or Delete Layer2 Interface configuration on AOS-CX.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface name, should be in the format chassis/slot/port, i.e. 1/2/3, 1/1/32. Please note, if the interface is a Layer3 interface in the existing configuration and the user wants to change the interface to be Layer2, the user must delete the L3 interface then recreate the interface as a Layer2.

options.name: interface_qos_rate
options.description:
The rate limit value configured for broadcast/multicast/unknown unicast traffic. Dictionary should have the format <type_of_traffic>: <speed>. e.g. unknown-unicast: 100pps
     broadcast: 200kbps
     multicast: 200pps

options.name: interface_qos_schedule_profile
options.description: Attaching existing QoS schedule profile to interface. *This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

options.name: native_vlan_id
options.description: VLAN trunk native VLAN ID, vlan_mode must be set to trunk.

options.name: native_vlan_tag
options.description: Flag for accepting only tagged packets on VLAN trunk native, vlan_mode must be set to trunk.

options.name: port_security_client_limit
options.description: Maximum amount of MACs allowed in the interface (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: port_security_enable
options.description: Enable port security in this interface (aoscx connection).

options.name: port_security_macs
options.description: List of allowed MAC addresses (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: port_security_recovery_time
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for recovery after a violation (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: port_security_sticky_learning
options.description: Enable sticky MAC learning (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: port_security_sticky_macs
options.description: Configure the sticky MAC addresses for the interface (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: port_security_violation_action
options.description: Action to perform when a violation is detected (aoscx connection). Only valid when port_security is enabled.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, Update, or Delete Layer2 Interface.

options.name: trunk_allowed_all
options.description: Flag for vlan trunk allowed all on L2 interface, vlan_mode must be set to trunk.

options.name: vlan_access
options.description: Access VLAN ID, vlan_mode must be set to access.

options.name: vlan_mode
options.description: VLAN mode on interface, access or trunk.

options.name: vlan_trunks
options.description: List of trunk VLAN IDs, vlan_mode must be set to trunk.
